html:
Venetia is the mainland of northeast Italy around Venice, Padua and Verona. In the 1783 map it still belongs to the Republic of Venice; by 1800 it is Austrian.

In 1797 Napoleon ended the thousand year old republic. By the Treaty of Campo Formio he handed Venice and its lands to Austria in exchange for other gains. From 1805 to 1814 it belonged to his Kingdom of Italy, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna returned it to the Austrian Empire, joined with Lombardy.

Venice rose in 1848 and held out as a republic for more than a year before it surrendered. Venetia stayed Austrian after Lombardy was lost in 1859. In 1866 Italy fought Austria alongside Prussia, and after Austria's defeat Venetia went to Italy, confirmed by a vote of its people.
sum: Venetia is the mainland of northeast Italy around Venice, Padua and Verona. In the 1783 map it still belongs to the Republic of Venice; by 1800 it is Austrian.
